To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the m-payment business model has to be designed in such a way, that it is able to provide the customer with a high degree of convenience, while the provider is enabled to generate a sufficient amount of revenue.

the success factors of an m-payment business are the right combination of the following: 1) a suitable market setting, 2) a proper market strategy, 3) a suitable technology, 4) a proper service provider strategy, 5) a proper user strategy, 6) a proper user interface, and 7) a proper business model.

m-payments are a business model with a high degree of interdependency between technical, human and marketing factors and that the success of a m-payment business model is highly dependent on the orchestration of these factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comprehensive framework for m-payment business modeling.
the development of a framework for m-payment business models.
developing a framework for analysis and development of m-payment business models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
m-payments are not dead, but they are not born either.
m-payments are a viable alternative to traditional payment methods, but that the current state is not yet satisfactory.
a holistic view of the m-payment system, including all influencing factors, is a necessary precondition for a successful business model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the m-payment business model ontology provides a comprehensive framework for analyzing existing and future m-payment business models.
the framework enables the analysis of the m-payment business model in a comprehensive manner and thus helps the decision making in m-payment business models.
m-payment business models are not only a combination of technical and market factors but also a result of a complex interaction of these factors and human decisions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

m-payment business models are a combination of a number of different business model elements, each of them being a complex combination of technical, human, and market factors, and that these elements need to be orchestrated in a comprehensive way in order to be successful.
the m-payment business model is not a single entity, but a system of interacting elements, and thus, it has to be analyzed in its entirety.
the business model framework can be used as a tool for the analysis of m-payment business models.
